title: Zoning text change for 289 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application amends the city's Mandatory Inclusionary Housing map to designate a portion of Williamsburg's Community District 1 as an MIH area. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would enable an 18-story mixed-use building at 289 Kent Avenue with 278 apartments, including 56 to 83 permanently income-restricted units, and about 29,300 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The Council approved the City Planning Commission's decision with modifications on October 8, 2026.
